description: Replace opaque panic messages in tachys with actionable diagnostic information when the SSR feature is unintentionally activated. When the SSR feature gets enabled in client-side builds, tachys currently panics with unhelpful messages that don't explain the root cause. Implement a shared diagnostic message that clearly explains the problem and provides troubleshooting steps for developers.
functional_requirements: Replace all existing panic messages in tachys HTML modules with a consistent diagnostic message when values are None due to SSR feature activation
Create a shared constant containing the diagnostic text that explains SSR feature conflicts and provides actionable troubleshooting advice
Ensure the diagnostic message clearly identifies that the SSR feature is active and explains why client-side values are being skipped
Include specific troubleshooting instructions in the message, including the command to run to identify the source of feature unification
Update all relevant panic locations in event handlers, directives, and properties modules to use the new diagnostic message
Maintain the same panic behavior but with improved messaging that helps developers understand and resolve the configuration issue
